about.metaDescription: Technentium is a new device repair service starting in Jaipur: clear prices, your approval before any work, and every step tracked.
about.title: A new way to get your device repaired.
about.intro: Technentium is a new repair service, starting in Jaipur. We are building repairs the way we would want them for our own phones: a clear price, no surprises, and you know what is happening at every step.
about.whyBody: Getting a phone or laptop fixed often means guesswork: a vague price, parts you can't check and no idea when it will be ready. We think it should be as simple and open as booking anything else online.

price.title: Price first
price.body: You see the diagnosis fee before you book and approve an itemised quote before any work starts.

handover.title: Your way
handover.body: Pickup and drop, walk in to our shop, or a technician at your door. Choose what suits you.

tracking.title: Always in the loop
tracking.body: Follow your repair from your account, from the moment we receive your device to the moment it is back.

warranty.title: Backed by warranty
warranty.body: Replaced parts and our workmanship are covered after the repair.

about.jaipurBody: We are starting small on purpose, in Jaipur only for now, so we can get every repair right. We will reach more cities as we grow. Protection products already ship across India.
